title: Physical Activity and Protein Supplementation After Bariatric Surgery (PAPAB)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine wether regular physical activity in combination with protein supplementation after bariatric surgery can reduce the loss of muscle mass and wether a computer-assisted exercise program is more effective than a usual exercise program regarding frequency of physical activity, fitness and muscular strength.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age of 18 - 65 years
* Body weight of ≤ 150 kg
* BMI \> 35 kg/m2
* Indication for laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy and laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass. The decision about the type of surgery is performed independent of the study by the surgeons in charge according to the German S3 guideline.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Kidney diseases of any kind
* Serious gastrointestinal diseases (e.g. Morbus Crohn, Colitis Ulcerosa, etc.)
* Serious musculoskeletal diseases
* Serious heart diseases (Myocardial infarction, stent implantation, stroke, etc.)
* Intake of blood thinning medicine (e.g. ASS, Marcumar, etc.)
